# Hosted API launch readiness

Owner: Ethan Park, Platform & Console
Decision status: Evidence review in progress (product, delivery, and design pass)

## Proposed capability and launch shape

Launch a staged public Hosted API surface for chat, completions, embeddings (single and batches up to 8), and server-side rerank. The contract is REST/OpenAPI, versioned and backward-compatible; core JS/Python SDKs, API-key/OAuth2 authentication, tier-aware quotas, retry guidance, structured chat output, streaming/SSE, deterministic embeddings, and stable rerank semantics are in scope. Dedicated/private deployment bundles and full non-core SDK parity are out of scope. Promotion is staged from internal burn-in to canary, regional expansion, and GA rather than a single all-at-once release. [PM-80421; dsid_6f6a548d740249f6a1413a8ab778f270; /knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-80421-hosted-api-capability-prioritization-acceptance-rollout.json]

## Product gates satisfied by current evidence

- Scope, non-goals, endpoint behavior, versioning, telemetry, SLO targets, rollout stages, and quantitative canary stop conditions are defined in the PRD.
- Design review of Console flows occurred; Leo Martinez requested explicit streaming-interruption error states. This is evidence of review, not final closure of that requested state.
- The delivery specification records agreement to keep rerank on a dedicated route, reducing autoscaler and tail-latency risk.

# Hosted API launch readiness

Owner: Ethan Park, Platform & Console
Decision status: Evidence review in progress (operational reconciliation complete)

## Proposed capability and supported launch shape

Launch a staged public Hosted API surface for chat, completions, embeddings (single and batches up to 8), and server-side rerank. The contract is REST/OpenAPI, versioned and backward-compatible; core JS/Python SDKs, API-key/OAuth2 authentication, tier-aware quotas, retry guidance, structured chat output, streaming/SSE, deterministic embeddings, and stable rerank semantics are in scope. [PM-80421; dsid_6f6a548d740249f6a1413a8ab778f270; /knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-80421-hosted-api-capability-prioritization-acceptance-rollout.json]

Operational evidence narrows the safe initial exposure to per-tenant allowlisted Hosted routes, internal dogfood first, then a design-partner cohort and 10–20-tenant soft launch, with broad availability only after the gates below pass. [dsid_fa0fb79e2f54457093ad3f831e7ac6a2; /knowledge/company/sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/release-engineering/hosted-canary-ga-change-management-checklist.json]

- Product scope, non-goals, endpoint behavior, versioning, telemetry, SLO targets, rollout stages, and quantitative PRD canary stop conditions are defined.
- Console flows received design review; explicit streaming-interruption error states remain a requested closure item.
- Rerank is intentionally a dedicated route to reduce autoscaler and tail-latency risk.
- The published 2026 SRE policy defines Hosted multi-region availability at 99.95% over a rolling 30-day window for paid, multi-region-eligible routes, with multi-window burn alerts and an SRE-review/change-freeze policy when error-budget consumption is high.
- The regional safeguard design has a working attenuation scheduler prototype and failure-injection harness; Security concluded no extra control beyond automatic weight-shift audit entries for that safeguard.

Product/design: [PM-80421; dsid_6f6a548d740249f6a1413a8ab778f270; /knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-80421-hosted-api-capability-prioritization-acceptance-rollout.json]. Delivery: [PM-51555; dsid_ada92facaa334d3688c6a8371e0d001a; /knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-51555-api-family-delivery-specification-chat-embeddings-rerank-launch-rundown.json]. SRE: [dsid_4a94c098221d4588837f9949309656bc; /knowledge/company/sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/multi-region-availability-slo-2026.json]. Rollback engineering: [ENG-87209; dsid_a4b927b2fb2f45cb97bddda127a2cb37; /knowledge/company/sources/linear/engineering/ENG-87209-hosted-api-regional-traffic-safeguard-playbook.json].

## Operational gates required before any external cohort

- SRE/Observability: pin route/cohort/region dashboards; verify fast, medium, and slow burn alerts; establish baseline SLO snapshot; confirm primary Eng Platform + SRE on-call coverage.
- Release: deploy and verify traffic splitting, orchestration, guardrails, telemetry tags, auto-stop/rollback, audit persistence, cohort dashboards, RBAC, customer docs, and the internal runbook.
- Security: complete the Hosted API threat-model/pen-test review and end-to-end KMS/key-rotation test; verify rollout audit events and RBAC behavior. Regional-safeguard security review does not substitute for the broader API security approval.
- Rollback: verify three kill switches (routing enforcement, new rollout creation/start, Console entry points); run create/start/1%/promote/pause/rollback E2E; force a stop-condition breach; prove baseline restoration and audit-event visibility.
- Reliability: set final auto-stop values, minimum sample/time window, and soak time; no blank thresholds may remain. Rollback safeguard acceptance requires two independent gates, resource-aware behavior, a safe drain/rehoming path, and an automated rollback integration test.
- Change management: check current Hosted error-budget state. Above 50% consumption, routing/failover changes require SRE on-call sign-off; above 100%, the reliability freeze applies except approved reliability fixes.

[dsid_fa0fb79e2f54457093ad3f831e7ac6a2; /knowledge/company/sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/release-engineering/hosted-canary-ga-change-management-checklist.json] [dsid_4a94c098221d4588837f9949309656bc; /knowledge/company/sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/multi-region-availability-slo-2026.json] [ENG-87209; dsid_a4b927b2fb2f45cb97bddda127a2cb37; /knowledge/company/sources/linear/engineering/ENG-87209-hosted-api-regional-traffic-safeguard-playbook.json]

## Current blockers and owners

| Automated safe drain, KV-hot prioritization, rollback test, and rehearsal | Liam O'Connor / SRE / Platform (ENG-87209, In Progress) |
| Rollback/runbook tabletop and kill-switch proof | SRE / Release / Control Plane |
| Streaming interruption error-state closure | Design / Console |

Delivery items: [PM-51555; dsid_ada92facaa334d3688c6a8371e0d001a; /knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-51555-api-family-delivery-specification-chat-embeddings-rerank-launch-rundown.json]. No external launch is supportable yet. arguments.content:
# Hosted API launch readiness

Owner: Ethan Park, Platform & Console
Final recommendation: **NO-GO for external launch; continue internal dogfood only**

## Decision

Do not enable the planned Hosted API capability for design partners, a soft-launch cohort, or broad availability yet. Continue internal dogfood and preflight validation behind tenant and global kill switches. Reconsider a limited, allowlisted Hosted-only cohort only after every accepted criterion below has evidence and the named approvers sign the go/no-go record. No launch date is proposed.

The product is coherent and customer demand is validated, but external exposure is not supportable while security, billing, release, rollback, beta-exit, and support gates remain incomplete or unproven. This is a no-go, not a rejection of the capability.

## Supported eventual launch scope

When gates pass, the supported first external scope is Hosted routes only, per-tenant allowlisted: chat/completions with streaming, embeddings (single and batches up to 8), and dedicated-route rerank through a versioned REST/OpenAPI contract and core JS/Python SDKs. It requires tier-aware quotas, billing, OAuth2/API keys, retry guidance, deterministic cohorting, guardrails, audit history, cohort metrics, and baseline rollback. Dedicated/private deployments, full non-core SDK parity, time-based step scheduling, automated quality gates, and custom per-tenant runtime/quantization remain out of scope. Start with a design-partner cohort; broad availability is a separate decision.

[PM-80421; dsid_6f6a548d740249f6a1413a8ab778f270; /knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-80421-hosted-api-capability-prioritization-acceptance-rollout.json] [dsid_fa0fb79e2f54457093ad3f831e7ac6a2; /knowledge/company/sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/release-engineering/hosted-canary-ga-change-management-checklist.json]

## Evidence supporting the capability

- The PRD defines the four endpoint families, compatibility rules, SLOs, telemetry, migration, and staged rollout.
- Six design partners used production rollouts. Four are recorded ready for GA and two conditional. Customers value percentage ramps, approval gates, metrics comparison, cohort stickiness, and rollback. Northstar’s how-to request closed after enablement and successful setup.
- The published SRE policy covers all four route families for paid multi-region-eligible Hosted traffic and defines a 99.95% rolling-30-day availability target plus actionable multi-window burn policy.
- Beta defects produced useful fixes and runbook requirements: the false-positive Northstar pause was resolved, and the split-mismatch mitigation was deployed before DocuSage completed its retry.

Customer/cohort: [dsid_22985fdc50d14444b0d278a5d93f5e08; /knowledge/company/sources/google_drive/shared_drives/product/console-and-rollouts/beta-design-partners-tracker-hosted-canary.json]. Support: [SUP-48211; dsid_c67a7f60aa1b4f3c81e82921aa73610a; /knowledge/company/sources/jira/customer-support/SUP-48211-how-do-i-do-a-percentage-rollout-on-hosted-route.json] [SUP-48302; dsid_dcdece5c12124b378e480e5c0d987a76; /knowledge/company/sources/jira/customer-support/SUP-48302-rollout-paused-unexpectedly-after-latency-spike.json]. SRE: [dsid_4a94c098221d4588837f9949309656bc; /knowledge/company/sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/multi-region-availability-slo-2026.json].

## Launch blockers

1. **Security approval is absent.** The broader Hosted API threat model, penetration test, KMS/key-rotation E2E, RBAC, and audit verification are required; the safeguard-specific review is insufficient. Owner: Security.
2. **Billing is not ready.** Token accounting and plan enforcement are todo and explicitly gate GA. Owner: Billing Engineering.
3. **Release controls are not evidenced complete.** The release checklist remains in review with deployment, migration, monitoring, RBAC, docs, runbook, kill-switch, and final-signoff boxes unresolved. Owners: Connor O’Brien / Platform / Smart Routing / Console / Security.
4. **Stop/soak defaults are not accepted.** The release checklist still has blank thresholds, while beta evidence shows false pauses for bursty/low-sample traffic. Owners: Product / SRE / Telemetry.
5. **Rollback is not proven to acceptance.** ENG-87209 is In Progress; safe drain/KV-hot prioritization, automated rollback integration, DR rehearsal, and game-day proof remain. Owner: Liam O’Connor with SRE and Platform.
6. **Beta exit is not demonstrated.** PM-1859 requires at least 10 completed E2E rollouts and no open P0/P1 split, rollback, or audit gaps. The tracker shows six partners but does not demonstrate 10 completed rollouts; Emberfin remains conditional on audit schema/policy messaging and HelioTravel on threshold guidance. Owners: Marissa Cole / Simran Kaur / Security / Policy / SRE.
7. **Support readiness is not approved.** Evidence of two training sessions, sampled tickets resolved using final macros, finalized escalation SLA/channel, and support signoff is missing. Owner: Dev Patel / Support.
8. **Delivery/doc closure remains.** OpenAPI/examples, SDK RC1, performance report, randomized rerank E2E, migration/billing FAQ, streaming interruption states, and 24/72-hour staffing remain incomplete. Owners: Docs, SDK, Performance, QA, Design/Console, Observability.

Delivery: [PM-51555; dsid_ada92facaa334d3688c6a8371e0d001a; /knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-51555-api-family-delivery-specification-chat-embeddings-rerank-launch-rundown.json]. Release: [dsid_fa0fb79e2f54457093ad3f831e7ac6a2; /knowledge/company/sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/release-engineering/hosted-canary-ga-change-management-checklist.json]. Rollback: [ENG-87209; dsid_a4b927b2fb2f45cb97bddda127a2cb37; /knowledge/company/sources/linear/engineering/ENG-87209-hosted-api-regional-traffic-safeguard-playbook.json]. Beta exit: [PM-1859; dsid_5444ca17e9664747930ead86571d4804; /knowledge/company/sources/linear/product-management/PM-1859-ga-launch-criteria-and-beta-exit-checklist-hosted-canary.json].

## Accepted launch criteria for reconsideration

All criteria are mandatory for the first external allowlist:

- Product/API: frozen, published OpenAPI; JS/Python RCs; migration guide; streaming-interruption states; backward-compatibility tests; billing/quotas verified with test tenants.
- Security: documented approval for threat model, pen test with critical/major remediation, KMS rotation E2E, RBAC, complete audit-event identity/diffs/route and rollout IDs.
- Reliability: current error-budget state checked; Hosted multi-region target and burn alerts live; final sample-size, grace-period, threshold, and soak defaults signed by SRE; actionable cohort/region dashboards.
- Release: all required components deployed and verified; backward-compatible migration; three kill switches tested; no open launch-blocking severity issue; change record and on-call coverage prepared.
- Rollback: staging and internal-production E2E proves create/start/step/pause/rollback, forced breach, baseline restoration, audit visibility, and safe drain; tabletop/game day completed with owners and escalation path.
- Cohort: PM-1859 beta exit met, including at least 10 completed E2E rollouts, at least five enabled partners/three production users, no open P0/P1 split/rollback/audit gaps, and partner comprehension of state, next action, stop reason, and rollback.
- Support/docs: two support trainings with recording, final macros and troubleshooting for auto-pause/split mismatch/approval denial, sample-ticket validation, escalation SLA/channel, streaming/retry/stickiness guidance, limitations, and formal Support signoff.
- Approvals: Product, Engineering (Console/Control Plane/Smart Routing), SRE, Security, Release, and Support signatures recorded in the single go/no-go checklist.

## Evidence-backed next steps

- Marcus Lin / Security: close audit schema consistency and complete the Hosted API security package.
- Ben Carter / Billing Engineering: demonstrate token accounting and plan enforcement end to end.
- Sean Gallagher, Aisha Bello, Paula Mendes: ratify tier/traffic-volume threshold, minimum-sample, grace-period, and soak defaults using the resolved Northstar false-pause evidence.
- Liam O’Connor, SRE, Platform: finish ENG-87209 and run the rollback/game-day evidence path.
- Simran Kaur / Marissa Cole: reconcile the design-partner tracker against PM-1859 and record the required completed-rollout count and issue closure.
- Dev Patel / Support: run two trainings, validate final macros against representative tickets, publish escalation ownership, and sign readiness.
- Connor O’Brien: convene go/no-go only after the checklist contains evidence links and all required signatures; do not infer approval from ticket status.

## Final recommendation

**NO-GO for external launch. Internal dogfood may continue under existing controls.** The next eligible decision is a conditional-go for a Hosted-only, per-tenant allowlist after every accepted criterion above is evidenced; broad availability requires a later go/no-go.

arguments.outcome: NO-GO for external launch; continue internal dogfood only pending accepted launch criteria.
